description: Replace all @@instance/Singleton class variables with dependency injection. Files affected: models.cr (30 hits), event_broadcaster (29), monitoring (29), task_metadata (28), favicon_cache (22), memory_budget (15), singleton.cr (15), fiber_tracker (14), rate_limiter (14), color_extractor (14), gc_collector (13), clustering_service (12). Architecture doc: 'Global state - shared mutable state between modules' is a red flag. This causes race conditions and makes modules untestable in isolation.

comments.text:
## Migration Plan

### Current State
- AppBootstrap (src/services/app_bootstrap.cr) is the composition root
- It creates services and manually sets Service.instance = ...
- 22 files call .instance on singletons
- models.cr has @@current/@@mutex/@@refreshing/@@clustering class vars
- infrastructure/singleton.cr defines def_singleton_manual/def_singleton_auto macros
- ADI (Athena DI) exists but only used by error_renderer.cr

### Approach: Incremental DI Migration

Phase 1: Foundation
- Register all services with ADI::Register annotations
- Make AppBootstrap use ADI.container for resolution
- Keep backward-compatible .instance during transition

Phase 2: Core Services (this ticket)
- Migrate DatabaseService, FeedCache, FeedFetcher to DI
- Migrate AppState (models.cr) from class vars to injected service
- Update AppBootstrap to inject rather than set-singleton

Phase 3: Actors
- Migrate FaviconActor, ClusteringActor, MemoryManagerActor to DI
- Update all .instance callers to receive injected deps

Phase 4: Cleanup
- Remove def_singleton_manual/def_singleton_auto macros
- Remove infrastructure/singleton.cr
- Remove all @@instance class variables

### Sub-tasks needed
The 22-file scope is too large for one pass. Break into:
1. ADI container setup + AppState service extraction
2. DatabaseService + FeedCache DI migration
3. FeedFetcher + fetcher layer DI migration
4. Actor layer DI migration
5. Controller layer DI migration
6. Singleton macro removal

title: Eliminate global state and singletons
